usedFor: Quora Lead Gen Forms captures leads and Brevo runs email lists, so “New Lead” can run “Add Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Quora Lead Gen Forms, then “Add Or Update Contact” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: A lead who fills a form lands in Brevo, and an existing contact is updated instead of repeated.

watchOut: “New Lead” is polling, so “Add Or Update Contact” runs after a scheduled check, not the moment a lead arrives.
